notes.title: Version 0.7.22.0 - World Gen and Building UI Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31494759/05385dbdfd2c27125a340c07bf791c7870b23c39.png[/img]

[h1]World Gen and Building UI Update[/h1]

This update is mostly focused on starting to normalize how the world gen system works, establishing a building system that feels accessible to the widest range of players, and optimizing a few things.

[h2]Version 0.7.22.0 - Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Simplified the building system to use a well-established 1m Grid snapping system, with the possibility of larger blocks later on that will fit into that grid. This is designed to maximize creative building while simplifying the mechanics for the sake of casual gameplay
[*] Initial spawn biome and weather is now consistent with a more neutral temperate region, from which the player will venture out to hotter or colder areas as they explore the world
[*] Updated ambient sound
[*] Added saving/loading of generated terrain
[*] Weather effects improved
[*] Forced the game to use DirectX 11 for the time being, due to reported issues with DirectX 12 and certain Radeon cards
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates VERY soon (likely in a week), which will feature vegetation and resources that the player can harvest! Fun!

notes.title: Version 0.7.21.0 - Infinite World and Build System Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31494759/c48f4dfcfb98f56da841fb08d74c1ffa72a7077d.png[/img]

[h1]Infinite World and Build System Improvements[/h1]

This took a minute, but this will mark a pretty significant expansion to game functionality, including infinite terrain generation as you explore the world. The barrier walls are down, and you're free to explore!  The build system has also been improved, and is now snapped to a 4m increment world grid, for convenient alignment of rooms and wall elements. This system will also fit in nicely with the random POI and dungeon generation that will be added in the near future.

[h2]Version 0.7.21.0 - Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed barrier walls, and added infinite terrain generation for limitless exploration
[*] Build mode has been improved and aligned to a 4m world grid
[*] New building parts have been added
[*] Weather and lighting effects have been improved
[*] Saving and Loading of structure elements is now functional (saving of world elements will be added very soon)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.7.20.5 - Survival Mode Testing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31494759/7aa62263ec2d4ff44325e7ea35596bdab7446b40.png[/img]

[h1]Survival Mode Testing and Visual Overhaul[/h1]

Now that we've found success with initial multiplayer tests, it's time to bring the open world survival elements back in, using the restructured map sequence and overall architecture. The plan is to have these essential gameplay elements stabilized and combined with the Steam multiplayer connectivity before the end of the year!

[h2]Version 0.7.20.5 - Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adventure mode with on foot navigation, aiming, and shooting grenades
[*] Build mode with category selection, block selection, breaking and building blocks, and block rotation
[*] Overhauled environment setup with day / night cycle, fog, and other visual tweaks
[*] New unique pixel art texture style which will be normalized across all structure and terrain elements as new building blocks and points of interest are added
[*] Distance based sound effects and ambience
[*] Streamlined controls to easily switch between Adventure mode and Build mode
[/list]

notes.title: Rheksetor Weekly Update - V7.9.9
notes.notes:
[h3]V7.9.9 Patch Notes[/h3]

This week's update features a brand new weapon for the player:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31494759/74b0ae527208071597ed9fd65d4420f973ba22f9.png[/img]

The CX-01 laser pistol is the first of several standard issue weapons that will be available in the near future. There will also be a large variety of randomly generated guns built from modular parts. These will drop randomly from loot boxes, enemies, etc.

Also included in this week's update is a proper ADS (aim down sight) animation, and some tweaks to environmental lighting and camera effects.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Major updates!
notes.notes:
So the first couple patches of the new game architecture are now live, with much more on the way!

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] it's a drastically different game, if you played the initial release where the main focus was on ship combat and world map construction.

The main focus is on sidescroller / platformer style action, but don't worry! Vehicles will return...

Some of the basic character combat mechanics are built, and structure building / removing as well. You can also collect some gems and throw them back at your enemies as grenades!

The next couple updates will fill out some of the HUD controls / icons / descriptions, and also add some more building construction options, so it will actually start to feel like a real game!

notes.title: World Building Update!
notes.notes:
Ahoy!

The first major update is now live, and players can start using the new sector building functions in the world map. There's also a brand new economic engine and new resources to collect.

The following is a summary of the changes included in the Feb 5th, 2018 update. There are many smaller elements which may have been added, scrapped, or otherwise modified over course of development, but these are the broad strokes. 

Future patch notes will likely move closer to being a more detailed account of smaller tweaks, fixes, and balance changes as the game's larger features/functions are solidified. 

At this stage, however, I believe it's more useful to talk about those larger scale things that are changing, rather than provide an exhaustive list of minor things.


[h1]V0762 Patch Notes:[/h1]
	
[b]Added rendering of plots and buildings on sectors.[/b]

[b]Remade sector sprites with sharper detail.[/b]

[b]Added zoom-in sector management mode:[/b]		
[list]
[*]displays expenses, incomes, and balances for all player resources
[*]allows selection of building plots, building types
[*]allows construction of those buildings
[/list]	

[b]Added economic engine, which does the following:[/b]
[list]
[*]processes production jobs for all buildings (jobs not shown yet)
[*]calculates all expenses and incomes based on jobs that are running
[*]keeps track of player resource totals
[*]calculates work force and housing requirements, etc (not fully integrated yet)
[*]processes game time, which is broken down into:
[list]
[*]seconds
[*]days (including night and day cycles)
[*]months
[*]then there is a much larger time scale of years, centuries, eras, eons, etc which is built into code, but not currently displayed 
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Partially rebuilt the data model for the world map and player resources.[/b]

[b]Updated the game save/load system to stay compliant with this.[/b]

[h1]Please Note[/h1]
All efforts are being made to try to stabilize the data model and save/load system as early as possible in the development process, but at this stage, players WILL have to delete their game saves and create new worlds for this update. I know it sucks, and being able to keep using a persistent world is very high on the priority list.

There's a lot more on the way, so stay tuned!
